operator_test.interpretation: Known-center oracle action test; dense and pixel-sampled cases separately reported. No prediction ability claimed.

physical_fit.interpretation: Fit pixel-integrated straight-edge model to 2D physically rendered inputs. Curved cases deliberately test mismatch. No fit uses target position.

provenance.scope: Actual image split plus source lineage, thesis motion selections and static image. Auxiliary sequence loaders inspected; historical per-batch sampling and all ancestor pretraining are not fully reconstructed.
provenance.claim_rule: Split membership means training eligibility, not proof that every eligible example was drawn. Repeated weighted sampling and final logs establish actual training mechanism; do not invent per-example access logs.
